verdict.rationale: Featurebase documents an HTTP API reference and serves an llms.txt docs index, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec. The probe found 404s at every standard openapi.json and swagger.json path. An llms.txt index and markdown API pages are adjacent documentation, not an API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
